tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
MAXSUN B760M D4 WIFI DDR4 Motherboard – LGA1700, Intel 12th/13th Gen

The MAXSUN B760M D4 WIFI is a compact Micro ATX motherboard built for Intel 12th and 13th Gen CPUs. Featuring DDR4 support up to 5333MHz, PCIe 5.0, triple M.2 slots, WiFi 6, 2.5G LAN, and ARGB headers, it's perfect for budget gaming and high-performance PC builds


Key Features:

  • Socket: LGA1700 – Supports Intel 12th & 13th Gen Core, Pentium, and Celeron processors
  • Chipset: Intel B760
  • Form Factor: Micro ATX (mATX)
  • Memory Support:
  • 4 x DDR4 DIMM slots
  • Up to 128GB, 5333MHz (OC)
  • Dual-channel, Intel XMP 2.0 support
  • Storage:
  • 3 x M.2 PCIe 4.0 slots
  • 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports
  • RAID 0/1/5/10 support
  • Expansion Slots:
  • 1 x PCIe 5.0 x16
  • 1 x PCIe 3.0 x1
  • Graphics Outputs:
  • 1 x HDMI 2.0
  • 1 x DisplayPort 1.4
  • Networking:
  • 2.5G LAN (Realtek RTL8125BG)
  • Intel WiFi 6 & Bluetooth 5.2
  • USB Ports:
  • Rear I/O: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen1, 6 x USB 2.0
  • Front Panel: USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen1, USB 2.0 headers
  • Audio: Realtek ALC897, 5.1 Channel HD Audio
  • Cooling & Power:
  • 10-phase power design
  • Premium thermal armor
  • Multiple fan headers & ARGB/RGB support
